review:
Cats chasing laser pointers on a 6x4 ways grid – and a rare Volatility Switch. Flip it to low for smaller, more frequent wins, or extreme for bigger, rarer ones, which is why we don't list a single rating.

The main mechanic is Wild Rows: laser cats on reels 2 to 6 fire a beam to the left, turning that whole row wild. Two cats on different rows can create massive ways counts. 12,500x max either way. A perfect game for finding your own preference in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
